output.text: {"notes":["The requested joint angles and angular velocities are joint-local quantities in rad and rad/s; angles use the stated unwrapped right-hand convention.","The tip position is a world-frame vector in meters; the world frame is right-handed with x-forward, y-left, and z-up.","A scheduled +0.5 N·m torque intervention acts on joint_1 over [0.5012, 0.6012) s, in addition to the stated applied torque.","joint_limit_by_T is true if either joint reaches an angle magnitude of 2.8 rad by T; contact onset is rearmed below 2.795 rad."]}
